description: How a frozen style's text sizes and spaces become sizes on one output format. A style holds the size of each text role and its smallest and largest text, every length a proportion of the format's reference text; a format holds that reference size, the steps text sizes stand on (textSteps: up to each `upTo`, sizes are multiples of its `step`) and its smallest legible text. Elements keep their own sizes and responsive steps, authored on the presentation format on its steps; on another format they scale with its reference size; no text falls below the style's smallest text. The page author reads the role sizes and states a size where a text's role calls for it.
